review_input.original_instruction: You begin staring at some gray curtains in a corner. Turn to your left and note the dining table to your left. Walk between the dining table and the windows, and towards the kitchen island with three bar stools. Once you are behind the left bar stool, turn right and move to the other side of the island. Once there, you should see that, upon turning left, you see a staircase. Go up the staircase. It turns left, in the middle, but you want to go all the way up. Once you're at the top you should see four paintings... Well, four pictures. One of them is a picture of a woman riding on a surfboard carried by four men. If you see that, you're in the right place. Turn left down the hall, and take the first door to the right. This leads to another hallway which you will go all the way down. You should end up near some green chairs. They're on the opposite side of a desk to a leather chair. Move towards that leather chair, next to the painting with all the abstract birds. Once you're behind the leather chair, near the abstract bird painting, turn back the way you came. You should be able to look through the wooden sliding door and see the door that was on the right when you were heading in. Go inside that door from here. You should be in a bedroom, with a bed with a green and white comforter. There's a picture of a giraffe on the right hand wall, and a poster that says 'Love' with a heart and less than symbol creating the... Or, with a three and less than symbol creating the heart. Turn to the left, moving along the foot of the bed. And you should end up next to a Campbell's tomato soup painting, and a dog bed. If you're in that corner you're done.
